context: Changes Token to own its text instead of borrowing it from the input.
explanation: tokenize previously borrowed each word directly from the source string (Token<'a> { text: &'a str }) with zero allocations. Switching to an owned String and calling word.to_string() per token heap-allocates and copies for every single token produced. On large inputs this turns a zero-copy tokenizer into one that allocates proportionally to token count, adding real allocator pressure in a hot parsing loop for no functional benefit.
